sql._комментарий: Ядро эту секцию не читает: для него это лишнее поле манифеста. Запросы правятся под своё приложение. Баз две: запрос с префиксом pg: уходит в Postgres, остальные — в SQLite. Строку подключения к Postgres класть в "pg" (или в переменную окружения APPDB_PG_DSN, чтобы пароль не лежал в файле).

users_total.parts: SELECT case when platform = 'android' then 'Android' when platform = 'ios' then 'iPhone' when coalesce(apns_token,'') <> '' then 'iPhone' when coalesce(fcm_token,'') <> '' then 'Android' else 'платформа неизвестна' end AS плат, count(*) AS n FROM users GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY (плат = 'платформа неизвестна'), n DESC

pairs_alive.query: pg:SELECT count(*) FROM groups WHERE NOT disbanded AND jsonb_array_length(members) >= 2

solo.query: pg:SELECT count(*) FROM groups WHERE NOT disbanded AND jsonb_array_length(members) = 1

new_day.query: SELECT count(*) FROM users WHERE created > datetime('now','-1 day')
new_day.delta: SELECT count(*) FROM users WHERE created > datetime('now','-2 day') AND created <= datetime('now','-1 day')
new_day.parts: SELECT case when platform = 'android' then 'Android' when platform = 'ios' then 'iPhone' when coalesce(apns_token,'') <> '' then 'iPhone' when coalesce(fcm_token,'') <> '' then 'Android' else 'платформа неизвестна' end AS плат, count(*) AS n FROM users WHERE created > datetime('now','-1 day') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY (плат = 'платформа неизвестна'), n DESC

regs_daily.query: SELECT substr(created,1,10) AS д, count(*) FROM users WHERE created > datetime('now','-30 day') GROUP BY д ORDER BY д

features.query: pg:SELECT 'Виджеты', count(DISTINCT group_id) FROM widget_data UNION ALL SELECT 'Настроения', count(DISTINCT group_id) FROM mood_entries UNION ALL SELECT 'Рисование', count(DISTINCT group_id) FROM canvas_strokes UNION ALL SELECT 'Чат', count(DISTINCT group_id) FROM chat_messages UNION ALL SELECT 'Скучаю', count(DISTINCT group_id) FROM miss_you

coins.parts: SELECT 'с монетами', count(*) FROM users WHERE coins>0

plus.query: SELECT count(*) FROM users WHERE plus=1
plus.parts: SELECT CASE WHEN plus_platform IS NULL OR plus_platform='' THEN 'неизвестно' ELSE plus_platform END, count(*) FROM users WHERE plus=1 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

cohorts.query: SELECT strftime('%Y, неделя %W', created) AS неделя, count(*), CASE WHEN max(created) < datetime('now','-7 day')      THEN sum(CASE WHEN updated > datetime(created,'+7 day') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) END, CASE WHEN max(created) < datetime('now','-30 day')      THEN sum(CASE WHEN updated > datetime(created,'+30 day') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) END FROM users WHERE created > datetime('now','-60 day') GROUP BY неделя ORDER BY неделя

pairs_life.query: pg:SELECT cast(avg(extract(epoch FROM (to_timestamp(disbanded_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') - to_timestamp(created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))) / 86400) AS int) FROM groups WHERE disbanded AND disbanded_at <> '' AND created_at <> ''
pairs_life.parts: pg:SELECT 'распались всего', count(*) FROM groups WHERE disbanded

files.parts: SELECT kind, count(*) FROM media GROUP BY kind ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 6

watch_kinds.query: SELECT case when coalesce(kind,'')='' then 'ссылка' else kind end, count(*) FROM watch_history WHERE created > datetime('now','-30 day') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 8
